diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: C0 has an arc to Cacc and an arc to CL; CL has a self-loop. The C0→Cacc path witnesses acceptance even though another branch loops.
diagram_candidates.reason: This example is explicitly about existential reachability versus a nonhalting sibling branch; a three-node diagram makes the contrast immediate.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw_or_check: Draw C0 as start with arrows C0→Cacc labeled (qacc,1,R) and C0→CL labeled (qL,1,L); add CL→CL self-loop. Mark Cacc accepting, CL nonhalting, and show the accepted path is length one. Do not imply every branch halts.
diagram_candidates.suggested_repair: Independent adjudicator should decide whether this diagram is warranted and verify the stated mathematical transitions/edges against the frozen source.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: The DFA for avoiding factor 11 has states ε, 1, ⊥; ε and 1 are accepting; δ(ε,0)=ε, δ(ε,1)=1, δ(1,0)=ε, δ(1,1)=⊥, and ⊥ loops on 0 and 1.
diagram_candidates.reason: The example gives a complete, tiny transition system and a direct language interpretation; a labeled state diagram would let the reader verify the sink completion and accepting set at a glance.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw_or_check: Use ε as the initial accepting state, 1 as accepting, ⊥ as rejecting sink. Draw ε --0→ ε, ε --1→ 1, 1 --0→ ε, 1 --1→ ⊥, and ⊥ loops labeled 0,1. Check this rejects exactly strings containing 11; retain the missing transition’s direction as 1 --1→ ⊥.
diagram_candidates.suggested_repair: Independent adjudicator should decide whether this diagram is warranted and verify the stated mathematical transitions/edges against the frozen source.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: The map Rdeg replaces each nonisolated vertex v of degree r by a cloud of its r incidence ports, places H_r with equality relations inside the cloud, and routes each old edge as an external edge between the designated ports with the original endpoint order; it then adds H_(2|E(G)|) and tautological loops to form G2. The decoder Dτ assigns each original vertex the plurality label among its ports.
diagram_candidates.reason: The definition contains two transformations and a decoding map whose port-level correspondence and orientation convention are easy to misread in prose; a schematic can display the actual map components without replacing the proof.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw_or_check: Show a source vertex v with incident ports p_e (a loop contributes two distinct ports); internal H_r edges carry equality relations; each original e={u,v} maps to one external edge between its designated ports carrying the same relation in the same endpoint order. Then show the overlay H_(2m) plus 65 tautological loops per port producing G2. Indicate Dτ(v)=plurality of the port labels with fixed-order tie break. Treat the empty-edge case separately as the empty graph. Do not reverse endpoint order, merge loop ports, or depict G2 overlay as changing the alphabet.
diagram_candidates.suggested_repair: Independent adjudicator should decide whether this diagram is warranted and verify the stated mathematical transitions/edges against the frozen source.
